title: Method for CaOx crystals isolation from plant leaves
author: Cerritos-Castro, Patrón-Soberano, et al.

steps.title: Grind fresh leaves
steps.instruction: Wash 100 g fresh plant leaves with tap water, then blend with 500 mL deionized water at maximum speed for 2–3 min until no large leaf fragments remain.

steps.title: Initial filtration and centrifugation
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate through eight layers of gauze, grind the retained residues with 160 mL deionized water for 2 min, filter again through a fresh eight‑layer gauze stack, centrifuge the filtrate at 2000 g for 10 min at room temperature, discard the supernatant and wash the resulting pellet with 200 mL deionized water.

substeps.instruction: Grind residues with 160 mL deionized water for 2 min.
Filter again through a new 8‑layer gauze.
Centrifuge filtrate at 2000 g for 10 min (RT).
Wash pellet with 200 mL deionized water.

steps.title: Lipid removal washes
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet sequentially with 100 mL 50 % ethanol, 100 mL 96 % ethanol, and 25 mL chloroform; centrifuge (conditions not specified) and allow the pellet to dry at room temperature.

steps.title: Chlorophyll removal and sampling
steps.instruction: Wash the dried pellet with 25 mL methanol at 60 °C for 5 min, centrifuge and let dry, then wash twice with 20 mL deionized water and take a 10 µL aliquot (Sample 1).

substeps.instruction: Wash with 25 mL MeOH at 60 °C for 5 min.
Wash twice with 20 mL deionized water.

steps.title: Cell‑wall digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the pellet with 10 mL cell‑wall digestion solution (1 % macerozyme, driselase, 10 mM MES, 5 mM CaCl₂) at 37 °C for 5 h while shaking at 300 rpm.

steps.title: Remove contaminating proteins
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with deionized water, then with 1 % Triton X‑100 solution for 40 min at 37 °C, wash subsequently with 20 mL deionized water followed by acetone to remove Triton, and collect a 10 µL aliquot (Sample 2).

substeps.instruction: Incubate with 1 % Triton X‑100 for 40 min at 37 °C.
Wash pellet with 20 mL deionized water.

steps.title: Strongly adhered protein extraction
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 10 mL protein extraction buffer (7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 2 % Triton X‑100), vortex 1 min, centrifuge, then wash the pellet four times with 20 mL deionized water; finally take a 10 µL aliquot (Sample 3).

substeps.instruction: Wash with 10 mL protein extraction buffer (7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 2 % Triton X‑100).
Wash pellet four times with 20 mL deionized water.

steps.title: Second cell‑wall digestion
steps.instruction: If debris remain, digest the pellet with 25 mL solution containing 0.5 % macerozyme in 10 mM MES (pH 5) and 5 mM CaCl₂ at 37 °C for 1 h while shaking at 300 rpm, centrifuge, wash with 20 mL deionized water, and take a 10 µL aliquot (Sample 4).

substeps.instruction: Digest with 25 mL 0.5 % macerozyme in 10 mM MES (pH 5) + 5 mM CaCl₂ at 37 °C for 1 h (300 rpm).
Wash pellet with 20 mL deionized water.

steps.title: Hydrolyze persistent proteins
steps.instruction: Digest the pellet with 25 mL saturated pancreatin in PBS (140 mM, pH 7.5) at 40 °C for 2 h while shaking at 300 rpm; centrifuge, wash with deionized water, then wash with 15 mL protein extraction buffer for 30 min while vortexing, centrifuge again, and wash sequentially with 15 mL 80 % acetone and 15 mL deionized water twice; finally collect a 10 µL aliquot (Sample 5).

substeps.instruction: Digest with 25 mL saturated pancreatin in PBS (140 mM, pH 7.5) at 40 °C for 2 h (300 rpm).
Wash with 15 mL protein extraction buffer, vortex 30 min.
Wash pellet twice with 15 mL deionized water.

steps.title: Density separation with polytungstate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL sodium polytungstate (density 1.9 g cm⁻³), vortex 10 min, centrifuge at 500 g for 30 min at room temperature, carefully remove the upper organic phase with a micropipette and decant the remainder without losing the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in 10 mL sodium polytungstate (1.9 g cm⁻³).
Remove upper organic phase with micropipette.
Decant remaining liquid, retaining the pellet.

steps.title: Wash and filter – Fraction 1
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet twice with 20 mL deionized water, resuspend in 5 mL fresh deionized water, then filter the suspension through a Whatman #113 filter paper (30 µm pore) using a syringe filter holder; collect the filtrate as Fraction 1.

substeps.instruction: Wash pellet twice with 20 mL deionized water.
Resuspend in 5 mL fresh deionized water.
Filter through Whatman #113 (30 µm) via syringe holder.

steps.title: Wash sediment – Fraction 2
steps.instruction: Pass 25 mL deionized water through the filter holder while shaking to wash the retained sediment; collect this filtrate as Fraction 2.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 mL deionized water to filter holder, shake.

steps.title: Vacuum filtration – Fractions 3 & 4
steps.instruction: Open the filter holder, wash the retained sediment with 25 mL deionized water, then vacuum‑filter it through a Whatman #113 filter; subsequently wash the sediment with ~25 mL deionized water. The filtrate is Fraction 3 and the residue remaining on the filter paper is Fraction 4.

substeps.instruction: Wash sediment with 25 mL deionized water.
Wash sediment with ~25 mL deionized water.
Collect residue on filter as Fraction 4.

steps.title: Final drying of fractions
steps.instruction: Centrifuge all fractions, discard the supernatants, and allow the crystal pellets to dry before storage for future analyses.
